lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu6Ir6 (reduced formula Mg2CuIr) crystallizes in the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 194), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: each Cu and Ir center has 12 Mg neighbors, while each Mg center has 12 neighbors (3 Cu, 3 Ir, 6 Mg), with neighbor distances of 2.8755–3.2649 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Cu–Ir pairs sharing corners and edges.
